text:
Harper: ran a short moderated session with 6 users on the playground invoke flow. recurring complaint: the toolbar's action is ambiguous. people don't know whether the action targets the highlighted function or the whole invocation. also icon-only affordances are getting ignored.
Eli: agree. proposal: show a tiny scope pill next to the verb (e.g., 'Run • selection' or 'Run • all'). pill keeps the main button compact but makes scope explicit. we can collapse the pill to a chevron for very narrow widths.
Sam: accessibility notes: current controls are icon-only at 16px and lack an aria-roledescription. request: 1) give the scope pill role="status" with aria-roledescription="scope indicator" so screen readers get context, 2) ensure pill has text (no color-only cues), 3) focusable target >= 24px. also respect prefers-reduced-motion for tooltip animations.
Juno: technical constraint: the toolbar lives inside the editor iframe (Monaco). we'll need a small event bus (postMessage) to move focus and to toggle scope. suggestion: add a lightweight focus-retainer that re-asserts focus to the originating control if iframe steals it.
Harper: UX compromise: keep the primary verb short ('Run' / 'Preview') and add the scope pill. tooltip on pill expands with full copy: "Runs the selected function only. Click to change scope to all functions in this invocation. Shortcut: Shift+Enter." tooltip should be reachable via aria-describedby.
Eli: run history phrasing: testers misread 'Ran 3s ago'. prefer tense clarity: use 'Completed 3s ago' for finished runs, 'Running (3s)' for live runs, 'Started 3s ago' for queued -> running transition. makes reading timeline easier.
Sam: status chips in history rely on color alone. recommend a small shape + text label: 'Succeeded'/'Errored' and add an aria-live politeness change when status flips. also add a short machine-readable attribute data-state for e2e assertions.
Juno: performance note: for long histories, render status chips as simple spans and replace with SVG icons only after they enter viewport (intersection observer). lazy-load sprite after 100ms post-render to avoid blocking main thread.
Harper: function-def editor placeholder: testers read 'args: {}' as "must fill". new placeholder: 'Try with: {"query":"weather in sf"}' and small helper: 'Examples accepted: JSON or YAML'. also add a dimmed sample toggle that inserts example content on click.
Eli: inline validation: +1 for a fast lint check. show a subtle green micro-check in gutter when schema passes and an inline red wavy underline with a tooltip for errors. consider debouncing lint to 350ms.
Sam: a11y modal flow: when the tool-calling modal opens, focus must move to first interactive element and be trapped. Escape closes modal and returns focus to trigger. also announce modal title using aria-modal and role="dialog" so SR users understand context.
ci-bot: CI: PR 5799 preview deployed to staging/playground-invoke. integration tests passed.
Juno: i'll split into two PRs: PR1 = accessibility + focus bus + modal semantics; PR2 = copy + scope pill + lazy svg + placeholder/examples.
Harper: can someone own final wording? @Eli can you author the final strings and push a small JSON diff to the copy repo by EOD tomorrow? I'll run a quick test with participants.
Eli: yes, i'll draft microcopy and include aria-describedby ids and sample JSON. will post diff and staging link.
Sam: i'll run axe + keyboard walkthroughs on staging and flag any unexpected focus traps.
Juno: tagging eng-runtime in case any server-side markers (run scope) need explicit metadata for the preview flow.
Harper: summary: compact verb + scope pill, explicit completed wording for history, status chips with shape+label+aria-live, modal focus semantics, placeholder with sample toggle, copy owner @Eli, staging smoke by @Sam, CI green. thanks all :sparkles:
